name: Trimetazidine
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

overview.class: Metabolic anti-ischemic agent (partial inhibitor of fatty acid oxidation)
overview.mechanism: Trimetazidine competitively inhibits the terminal enzyme of mitochondrial fatty acid beta-oxidation, shifting heart and muscle energy production from free fatty acids toward glucose oxidation, which uses less oxygen per unit of ATP. Its anti-ischemic effect occurs without changes in heart rate or blood pressure.
uses: Stable angina pectoris, as add-on therapy when symptoms are not controlled by, or the patient cannot tolerate, first-line antianginal drugs (beta-blockers, calcium channel blockers, nitrates)
Its benefit on long-term mortality and morbidity in ischemic heart disease and heart failure has not been confirmed in adequately designed randomized trials
